q: Furstenberg's 2×3 theorem (1967) states that the only infinite closed subsets of [0,1) invariant under both x ↦ 2x (mod 1) and x ↦ 3x (mod 1) are:
exp: Furstenberg's ×2 ×3 conjecture (proved for closed sets, still open for ergodic measures): the only infinite closed set simultaneously invariant under ×2 and ×3 is [0,1). The measure version (only common invariant ergodic measure is Lebesgue) remains open—it is implied by normality of all numbers.
